about_the_game:
The globally beloved protagonist of NieR:Automata, 2B, is coming to Desktop Mate! Enjoy her charm with authentic voice lines extracted directly from the original game, featuring a function to freely switch between Japanese voice (CV: Yui Ishikawa) and English voice (CV: Kira Buckland).

The Desktop Mate version of 2B includes a host of motions that fans of the original game have been waiting for. Her signature movements have been faithfully recreated in every detail, such as her subtly crossing her legs, sitting facing away, and the motion of adjusting her knee-high socks.

Key Features:

  • Includes a function to switch between Japanese and English voices.

  • Support unit Pod 042 appears during specific motions.

  • Beautiful graphics and natural movements realized with the latest 3D technology.

  • 3D model and motions created exclusively for Desktop Mate.

  • 2B's motion capture, just like the original game, was performed by Kaori Kawabuchi.

Important Notes:

  • Desktop Mate is required to use this content. Please update to the latest version before use.

  • This content can be used for video streaming on platforms such as YouTube, Niconico Douga, and Twitch.

[This Product Includes]

NieR:Automata YoRHa No.2 Type B
